name: Workflow Heroku Demo
description: Deploy a small durable Workflow DevKit demo backed by the personal, unofficial Heroku World and Heroku Postgres.

NODE_ENV.description: Run the demo using production settings.

WORKFLOW_HEROKU_API_TOKEN.description: Bearer token required by the demo API. Retrieve it from the app's Heroku config vars.

WORKFLOW_HEROKU_DATABASE_CONNECTION_LIMI.description: Connection limit of the attached Essential-0 database.

WORKFLOW_HEROKU_ENCRYPTION_CONTEXT.description: Stable application-specific context for per-run encryption key derivation.

WORKFLOW_HEROKU_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Stable 32-byte master key generated as 64 hexadecimal characters. Never rotate it while encrypted runs remain.

WORKFLOW_HEROKU_JOB_PREFIX.description: Graphile Worker task prefix for the demo.

WORKFLOW_TARGET_WORLD.description: Workflow World package loaded by Workflow DevKit.

WORKFLOW_HEROKU_WORKER_CONCURRENCY.description: Embedded Graphile Worker concurrency for the single demo web process.

WORKFLOW_HEROKU_MAX_POOL_SIZE.description: Postgres connections reserved for Workflow in the single demo web process.

WORKFLOW_HEROKU_PROCESS_COUNT.description: Number of web processes that instantiate the World. Update this before scaling the formation.

WORKFLOW_HEROKU_RELEASE_POLICY.description: Block code releases while any non-terminal workflow run could replay against a different application version.

WORKFLOW_QUEUE_NAMESPACE.description: Workflow SDK queue namespace shared by the runtime and World.
